12 # Trigonometric and hyperbolic trigonometric functions
13 
14 This file contains the definitions of the sine, cosine, tangent,
15 hyperbolic sine, hyperbolic cosine, and hyperbolic tangent functions.

24 namespace Complex

26 noncomputable section
27 
28 /-- The complex sine function, defined via `exp` -/
29 @[pp_nodot]
30 def sin (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
31   (exp (-z * I) - exp (z * I)) * I / 2
32 
33 /-- The complex cosine function, defined via `exp` -/
34 @[pp_nodot]
35 def cos (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
36   (exp (z * I) + exp (-z * I)) / 2
37 
38 /-- The complex tangent function, defined as `sin z / cos z` -/
39 @[pp_nodot]
40 def tan (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
41   sin z / cos z
42 
43 /-- The complex cotangent function, defined as `cos z / sin z` -/
44 def cot (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
45   cos z / sin z
46 
47 /-- The complex hyperbolic sine function, defined via `exp` -/
48 @[pp_nodot]
49 def sinh (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
50   (exp z - exp (-z)) / 2
51 
52 /-- The complex hyperbolic cosine function, defined via `exp` -/
53 @[pp_nodot]
54 def cosh (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
55   (exp z + exp (-z)) / 2
56 
57 /-- The complex hyperbolic tangent function, defined as `sinh z / cosh z` -/
58 @[pp_nodot]
59 def tanh (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
60   sinh z / cosh z
61 
62 end
63 
64 end Complex

72 /-- The real sine function, defined as the real part of the complex sine -/
73 @[pp_nodot]
74 nonrec def sin (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
75   (sin x).re
76 
77 /-- The real cosine function, defined as the real part of the complex cosine -/
78 @[pp_nodot]
79 nonrec def cos (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
80   (cos x).re
81 
82 /-- The real tangent function, defined as the real part of the complex tangent -/
83 @[pp_nodot]
84 nonrec def tan (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
85   (tan x).re
86 
87 /-- The real cotangent function, defined as the real part of the complex cotangent -/
88 nonrec def cot (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
89   (cot x).re
90 
91 /-- The real hyperbolic sine function, defined as the real part of the complex hyperbolic sine -/
92 @[pp_nodot]
93 nonrec def sinh (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
94   (sinh x).re
95 
96 /-- The real hyperbolic cosine function, defined as the real part of the complex hyperbolic cosine
97 -/
98 @[pp_nodot]
99 nonrec def cosh (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
100   (cosh x).re
101 
102 /-- The real hyperbolic tangent function, defined as the real part of
103 the complex hyperbolic tangent -/
104 @[pp_nodot]
105 nonrec def tanh (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
106   (tanh x).re
107 
108 end

116 theorem two_sinh : 2 * sinh x = exp x - exp (-x) :=
117   mul_div_cancel₀ _ two_ne_zero
118 
119 theorem two_cosh : 2 * cosh x = exp x + exp (-x) :=
120   mul_div_cancel₀ _ two_ne_zero

128 private theorem sinh_add_aux {a b c d : ℂ} :
129     (a - b) * (c + d) + (a + b) * (c - d) = 2 * (a * c - b * d) := by ring

131 theorem sinh_add : sinh (x + y) = sinh x * cosh y + cosh x * sinh y := by
132   rw [← mul_right_inj' (two_ne_zero' ℂ), two_sinh, exp_add, neg_add, exp_add, eq_comm, mul_add, ←
133     mul_assoc, two_sinh, mul_left_comm, two_sinh, ← mul_right_inj' (two_ne_zero' ℂ), mul_add,
134     mul_left_comm, two_cosh, ← mul_assoc, two_cosh]
135   exact sinh_add_aux

342 theorem sin_sub_sin : sin x - sin y = 2 * sin ((x - y) / 2) * cos ((x + y) / 2) := by
343   have s1 := sin_add ((x + y) / 2) ((x - y) / 2)
344   have s2 := sin_sub ((x + y) / 2) ((x - y) / 2)
345   rw [← add_div, add_sub, add_right_comm, add_sub_cancel_right, add_self_div_two] at s1
346   rw [div_sub_div_same, ← sub_add, add_sub_cancel_left, add_self_div_two] at s2
347   rw [s1, s2]
348   ring
349 
350 theorem cos_sub_cos : cos x - cos y = -2 * sin ((x + y) / 2) * sin ((x - y) / 2) := by
351   have s1 := cos_add ((x + y) / 2) ((x - y) / 2)
352   have s2 := cos_sub ((x + y) / 2) ((x - y) / 2)
353   rw [← add_div, add_sub, add_right_comm, add_sub_cancel_right, add_self_div_two] at s1
354   rw [div_sub_div_same, ← sub_add, add_sub_cancel_left, add_self_div_two] at s2
355   rw [s1, s2]
356   ring

358 theorem sin_add_sin : sin x + sin y = 2 * sin ((x + y) / 2) * cos ((x - y) / 2) := by
359   simpa using sin_sub_sin x (-y)

361 theorem cos_add_cos : cos x + cos y = 2 * cos ((x + y) / 2) * cos ((x - y) / 2) := by
362   calc
363     cos x + cos y = cos ((x + y) / 2 + (x - y) / 2) + cos ((x + y) / 2 - (x - y) / 2) := ?_
364     _ =
365         cos ((x + y) / 2) * cos ((x - y) / 2) - sin ((x + y) / 2) * sin ((x - y) / 2) +
366           (cos ((x + y) / 2) * cos ((x - y) / 2) + sin ((x + y) / 2) * sin ((x - y) / 2)) :=
367       ?_
368     _ = 2 * cos ((x + y) / 2) * cos ((x - y) / 2) := ?_
369   · congr <;> field
370   · rw [cos_add, cos_sub]
371   ring

547 theorem cos_add_sin_mul_I_pow (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :

551 open Finset
552 
553 theorem cos_bound {x : ℂ} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖cos x - (1 - x ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96) :=
554   calc
555     ‖cos x - (1 - x ^ 2 / 2)‖ =
556         ‖(exp (-x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (-x * I) ^ m / m.factorial) / 2 +
557          (exp (x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (x * I) ^ m / m.factorial) / 2‖ := by
558       simp [cos, field, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial]
559       grind [I_sq, two_ne_zero]
560     _ ≤ ‖exp (-x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (-x * I) ^ m / m.factorial‖ / 2 +
561         ‖exp (x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (x * I) ^ m / m.factorial‖ / 2 := by
562       grw [norm_add_le]
563       simp
564     _ ≤ ‖-x * I‖ ^ 4 * (Nat.succ 4 * (Nat.factorial 4 * (4 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) / 2 +
565         ‖x * I‖ ^ 4 * (Nat.succ 4 * (Nat.factorial 4 * (4 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) / 2 := by
566       grw [exp_bound (by simpa) (by simp), exp_bound (by simpa) (by simp)]
567     _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96) := by norm_num
568 
569 theorem sin_bound {x : ℂ} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖sin x - (x - x ^ 3 / 6)‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96) :=
570   calc
571     ‖sin x - (x - x ^ 3 / 6)‖ =
572         ‖(exp (-x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (-x * I) ^ m / m.factorial) * I / 2 -
573          (exp (x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (x * I) ^ m / m.factorial) * I / 2‖ := by
574       simp [sin, field, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial]
575       grind [I_sq, two_ne_zero]
576     _ ≤ ‖exp (-x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (-x * I) ^ m / m.factorial‖ / 2 +
577         ‖exp (x * I) - ∑ m ∈ range 4, (x * I) ^ m / m.factorial‖ / 2 := by
578       grw [norm_sub_le]
579       simp
580     _ ≤ ‖-x * I‖ ^ 4 * (Nat.succ 4 * (Nat.factorial 4 * (4 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) / 2 +
581         ‖x * I‖ ^ 4 * (Nat.succ 4 * (Nat.factorial 4 * (4 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) / 2 := by
582       grw [exp_bound (by simpa) (by simp), exp_bound (by simpa) (by simp)]
583     _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96) := by norm_num
584

881 theorem cos_bound {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) : |cos x - (1 - x ^ 2 / 2)| ≤ |x| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) := by
882   simpa [← ofReal_cos, ← norm_eq_abs, ← norm_real] using Complex.cos_bound (x := x) (by simpa)
883 
884 theorem sin_bound {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) : |sin x - (x - x ^ 3 / 6)| ≤ |x| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) := by
885   simpa [← ofReal_sin, ← norm_eq_abs, ← norm_real] using Complex.sin_bound (x := x) (by simpa)
886 
887 theorem cos_pos_of_le_one {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) : 0 < cos x :=
888   calc 0 < 1 - x ^ 2 / 2 - |x| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) :=
889       sub_pos.2 <|
890         lt_sub_iff_add_lt.2
891           (calc
892             |x| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) + x ^ 2 / 2 ≤ 1 * (5 / 96) + 1 / 2 := by
893                   gcongr
894                   · exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) hx
895                   · rw [sq, ← abs_mul_self, abs_mul]
896                     exact mul_le_one₀ hx (abs_nonneg _) hx
897             _ < 1 := by norm_num)
898     _ ≤ cos x := sub_le_comm.1 (abs_sub_le_iff.1 (cos_bound hx)).2
899 
900 theorem sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_one {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx : x ≤ 1) : 0 < sin x :=
901   calc 0 < x - x ^ 3 / 6 - |x| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) :=
902       sub_pos.2 <| lt_sub_iff_add_lt.2
903           (calc
904             |x| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) + x ^ 3 / 6 ≤ x * (5 / 96) + x / 6 := by
905                 gcongr
906                 · calc
907                     |x| ^ 4 ≤ |x| ^ 1 :=
908                       pow_le_pow_of_le_one (abs_nonneg _)
909                         (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hx0)]) (by decide)
910                     _ = x := by simp [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hx0)]
911                 · calc
912                     x ^ 3 ≤ x ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (le_of_lt hx0) hx (by decide)
913                     _ = x := pow_one _
914             _ < x := by linarith)
915     _ ≤ sin x :=
916       sub_le_comm.1 (abs_sub_le_iff.1 (sin_bound (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hx0)]))).2
917 
918 theorem sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_two {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx : x ≤ 2) : 0 < sin x :=
919   have : x / 2 ≤ 1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by simp)).mpr (by simpa)
920   calc
921     0 < 2 * sin (x / 2) * cos (x / 2) :=
922       mul_pos (mul_pos (by simp) (sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_one (half_pos hx0) this))
923         (cos_pos_of_le_one (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (half_pos hx0))]))
924     _ = sin x := by rw [← sin_two_mul, two_mul, add_halves]
925 
926 theorem cos_one_le : cos 1 ≤ 5 / 9 :=
927   calc
928     cos 1 ≤ |(1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) + (1 - 1 ^ 2 / 2) :=
929       sub_le_iff_le_add.1 (abs_sub_le_iff.1 (cos_bound (by simp))).1
930     _ ≤ 5 / 9 := by norm_num
931 
932 theorem cos_one_pos : 0 < cos 1 :=
933   cos_pos_of_le_one (le_of_eq abs_one)
934 
935 theorem cos_two_neg : cos 2 < 0 :=
936   calc cos 2 = cos (2 * 1) := congr_arg cos (mul_one _).symm
937     _ = _ := Real.cos_two_mul 1
938     _ ≤ 2 * (5 / 9) ^ 2 - 1 := by
939       gcongr
940       · exact cos_one_pos.le
941       · apply cos_one_le
942     _ < 0 := by norm_num
943 
944 end Real

946 namespace Mathlib.Meta.Positivity
947 open Lean.Meta Qq
948 
949 /-- Extension for the `positivity` tactic: `Real.cosh` is always positive. -/
950 @[positivity Real.cosh _]
951 meta def evalCosh : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _ _ e := do
952   match u, α, e with
953   | 0, ~q(ℝ), ~q(Real.cosh $a) =>
954     assertInstancesCommute
955     return .positive q(Real.cosh_pos $a)
956   | _, _, _ => throwError "not Real.cosh"
957 
958 example (x : ℝ) : 0 < x.cosh := by positivity
959 
960 end Mathlib.Meta.Positivity

964 @[simp]
965 theorem norm_cos_add_sin_mul_I (x : ℝ) : ‖cos x + sin x * I‖ = 1 := by
966   have := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
967   simp_all [add_comm, norm_def, normSq, sq, sin_ofReal_re, cos_ofReal_re, mul_re]
968 
969 @[simp]
970 theorem norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (x : ℝ) : ‖exp (x * I)‖ = 1 := by
971   rw [exp_mul_I, norm_cos_add_sin_mul_I]
972 
973 @[simp]
974 theorem norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal (x : ℝ) : ‖exp (I * x)‖ = 1 := by
975   rw [mul_comm, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
976 
977 @[simp]
978 theorem nnnorm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (x : ℝ) : ‖exp (x * I)‖₊ = 1 := by
979   rw [← nnnorm_norm, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, ← NNReal.coe_eq_one]; simp
980

983   rw [← nnnorm_norm, norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, ← NNReal.coe_eq_one]; simp

985 @[simp]
986 theorem enorm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (x : ℝ) : ‖exp (x * I)‖ₑ = 1 := by
987   simp [← ENNReal.toReal_eq_one_iff]
988 
989 @[simp]
990 theorem enorm_exp_I_mul_ofReal (x : ℝ) : ‖exp (I * x)‖ₑ = 1 := by
991   simp [← ENNReal.toReal_eq_one_iff]
992 
993 theorem norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one (x : ℝ) : ‖exp (I * x) - 1‖ = ‖2 * Real.sin (x / 2)‖ := by
994   rw [show ‖2 * Real.sin (x / 2)‖ = ‖2 * sin (x / 2)‖ by norm_cast, two_sin]
995   nth_rw 2 [← one_mul (_ - _), ← exp_zero]
996   rw [← neg_add_cancel (x / 2 * I), exp_add, mul_assoc _ _ (_ - _), mul_sub, ← exp_add, ← exp_add,
997     ← add_mul, ← add_mul]; norm_cast
998   rw [add_neg_cancel, ofReal_zero, zero_mul, exp_zero, add_halves, ← neg_mul, Complex.norm_mul,
999     norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_mul,
1000     show -(ofReal (x / 2)) = ofReal (-x / 2) by norm_cast; exact neg_div' 2 x,
1001     norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, ← norm_neg, neg_sub, mul_comm]
1002 
1003 theorem norm_exp (z : ℂ) : ‖exp z‖ = Real.exp z.re := by
1004   rw [exp_eq_exp_re_mul_sin_add_cos, Complex.norm_mul, norm_exp_ofReal, norm_cos_add_sin_mul_I,
1005     mul_one]

1007 theorem norm_exp_eq_iff_re_eq {x y : ℂ} : ‖exp x‖ = ‖exp y‖ ↔ x.re = y.re := by
1008   rw [norm_exp, norm_exp, Real.exp_eq_exp]
1009
